title: Hino 2016 FM Hino Non FUPS polished Alloy Bullbar #8
description: Hino 500 4 post hi-tensile polished aluminium heavy duty Bullbar with heavy duty box style uprights. One piece heavy duty 63mm cross pipes. Contoured main channel with heavy duty steel backing plate and tow pin. Custom built removable headlight protectors. Custom driving light mounts to customer specification.
